brands.name: Outer Island Surfboards
brands.short_description: Mitchell Rae's Outer Island templates — Australian-made boards with Hawaiian design lineage, flex-tail innovation, and five decades of hand-shaping heritage.

models.name: Blade Runner
models.description: The Blade Runner is the blood brother design to the Moon Raker. it utilises the same outline and overall fluid dynamics as its counterpart in a more compact overall design - the bullet-like outline paired with a crescent tail delivers astonishing projection and release. The deep central concave is the warp speed engine, supplying incredible drive and lift from wave entry. I added design elements of double rail channels, with speed and control in mind. This heightened drive and traction ensures that the Blade Runner can handle steep faces, long sections and deep tubes. Using V2 Flex construction, the rear third of the board is alive with flex, delivering slingshot-like exit from turns. There is nothing like riding a flexible blade! Suggested wave range:2 -8ft Recommended fin configuration: Dedicated quad.

models.name: Coral Reefer
models.description: Riding a bigger board gives you the clear advantage to sit out from the pack and pick off the bombs, get in early, set the wave up. Once you’re up and running the Reefer rides much smaller than it measures, especially off your back foot. You can do full S turns in and around the pocket, full tail turns and forward trim tube riding are a joy. The essential board in your quiver for those bigger days and challenging conditions. A little less rocker, more planning area and volume than a true gun makes the Coral Reefer a really versatile design which you can surf on small to medium days as well as those serious swells that we have been enjoying. The luxurious paddle power is a blessing at the points in the heavy sweep. For much of my shaping career, I have been known as being the go-to guy in Australia for state-of-the-art step-ups and guns for waves of consequence. Be it Indo, Fiji or an epic Aussie swell, Outer Guns have been trusted by the best for over fifty years. The Coral Reefer is the embodiment of all that acquired knowledge, feedback and personal experience in a user-friendly package. Give yourself an unfair advantage with a Coral Reefer. Suggested wave range: You can ride them from 3 feet to 20

models.name: Flextail Zen Blade
models.description: This Zen Blade Flextail features 3 x cedar stringers Glass tints in natural earth colour / 6oz bottom / 6x6 oz deck Hand made glassed on single fin in carbon fibre and tinted natural earth colour glass. Tail is full carbon fibre with EVA foam / Art meets science Its very rare for me to offer a stock board of this calibre , usually I build them to custom orrder only. Its a flexible blade , with variable curve , delivering adjustable arcs and turns , pop and twang . There's nothing like riding a flexible blade! I have devoted fifty years to experimentation, refinement and the advocacy of flexible variable curves in surfboards. I could argue that along with concaves, the exploration of flex and the development of its most technical execution is my most significant contribution to surfing. I have been pioneering both since the early 1970’s. If you ask anyone who has ridden an Outer Island Flextail, they will speak to you of previously unexperienced levels of energy built through turns and drive that feels like there is no top end to your board speed. Like a dolphin’s tail, the Flextail generates propulsion, drive and acceleration out of the turns. The tail flexes as you apply power, carving a tighter arc the harder you extend through your turn. Energy is loaded in the carbon tail and released when coming out of the turn (reflex) delivering drive and acceleration, like a diver launching from a spring board, or an arrow loosed from a bow. Unlike conventional boards which are rigid and have one inbuilt set of curves, the flextail means that the board has variable curves. Imagine a board with optimal rocker for innate board speed on takeoff and trimming. Now, imagine increased tail rocker delivering arcs from wide to tight, based on the pressure applied during the turn by the rider. And you have the Flextail. Flextails feel alive to ride, utterly responsive to wave shape and conditions, carving variable arcs and springing out of turns with a sling shot effect. I produce Flextails in 2 kinds of construction: 1: the original classic transparent fibreglass laminate , inspired by George Greenough’s flexible spoons. 2: Outer Island’s proprietary high end composite construction incorporating carbon fibre, high-end vinyl ester resin and EVA flexible foam rubber. It is unquestionably the most advanced technology available today. Flextails can be built in all models excluding traditional longboards. They have always been highly sought after by surfers chasing waves of consequence. When Derek Hynd built his Search quiver for J Bay in the 1990’s, he commissioned a brace of Flextails that ended up being used to stunning effect by both he and Tom Curren. Unashamedly, Flextails aren’t cheap. But neither is a Ferrari or a Porsche. These are lifetime boards. Typically, the surfer who invests in a Flextail ends up coming back for more. Because there is nothing that compares to a flexible blade…

models.name: Free Spirit
models.description: Free Spirit I've built a number of boards based around this design for friends over the years. The feedback has been so positive that it's finally earned its place in the stable as a model in its own right. Designed to deliver effortless paddle power, early wave entry and loads of natural board speed, the Free Spirit has the ability to ride much smaller than its dimensions suggest — carving surprisingly tight arcs deep in the pocket while maintaining glide, flow and drive. It's a true one-board quiver. Heading for Byron, Bells, Bali, G-Land, J-Bay or beyond? This is the board for you. Referencing the best design ingredients gathered over many decades, the Free Spirit combines a relaxed rocker, beak nose carrying generous forward volume, and a curvy yet highly positive outline. A subtle concave helps get it up and riding on air, while the tucked edge running nose to tail delivers speed, drive and responsiveness. The swallow tail allows quick direction changes, positive hold in the tube and the ability to surf tight in the pocket when required. Set up as either a Quad or Thruster, it's equally at home drawing long flowing lines or being pushed hard through a turn. A board for the ages. Construction • 1" Balsa centre stringer • Twin 3mm Cedar stringers • Double 6oz deck and 6oz bottom glassing • Handmade roving loop for added strength, character and class • Full gloss and mirror polished finish Built by hand. Built to last. Built to be ridden.

models.name: KISS
models.description: Keep it Simple! The intention of the KISS is to connect with that feeling and keep it simple. To pare those great design fundamentals back to their essence of beautiful outline, rocker, foil and rail. The magic of this design is in the pure resolution of planing area, curve, rocker and thickness distribution. The KISS has a subtle concave for 2/3 of the board, splitting into a refined yet subtle double concave / Vee behind the back foot. A rail chine / V combination entry under the nose keeps the KISS loose and catch free. Medium low rails with a tucked under edge all the way around the board ensures positive and continuous flow through turns. It’s a design which will work in every kind of wave. You can go to the beach with one board in your car, knowing you have the right board every time. Board lengths: The KISS works right through the size range from mid 5’8” to mid lengths.

models.name: MOONRAKER
models.description: MOONRAKER The birth of the MoonRaker design concept came to me driving home from sharing afternoon tea with the Guru of Flex, George Greenough where we talked story and discussed our shared lifetime passion for Flex. Using the longer lines of a 7'4 pintail gun, I then 4'' cut from the nose to shorten overall length while holding the long projection lines. The Moonraker has low entry rocker with a parabolic, progressive speed-continuous curve throughout, mirrored and accentuated through the concave. Quick release rocket tail, fed by a deep single concave within defined twin narrow vee control planes loosen the design right up without sacrificing drive. When I launched the first protype, I was fortunate to get a test session of 3-6ft down the line waves, 200 + yard rides. The board literally flew, at times barely contacting the water...quick as lightning, long speed arcs...and total control in tight carves and S turns. The low rocker gives exceptionally easy wave entry and instant board speed, the V2Flex construction enables variable arcs and slingshot / reflex projection. Driving this board hard, cranking it down the hi line, it has no "top end " limitation to its speed and will keep going faster and faster with the wave. The Switch Blades fins felt totally positive, an integral part of the board, drag utterly minimised. The concept was absolutely proven and the Moonraker was released to my customers. I rate this board as an absolute break through design that incorporates so much of my fifty plus year exploration of concaves into it. The Moonraker design translates well right through the size range from under 6 ft to 8ft. Suggested wave range: 2- 8 feet + Fin configurations recommended: with its broad tail, its best as a dedicated quad fin

models.name: Smart Board
models.description: The Smart weapon of choice, the intuitive every day driver. This board has a medium rocker , hidden central foam for ease of paddling and early wave entry. Fast bottom to extract maximum speed and power from small to medium size waves. Recommended as a round tail, this enables smooth rail-to-rail transitions and cutbacks. Go with the squash tail option for competitive performance style surfing.

models.name: Soul Slider
models.description: The classic early 60’s Australian longboard, lightly dusted with some modern magic. A balanced design well suited for all levels of surfer, experienced or just discovering the joy of longboard surfing. Medium area nose nose, hippy behind center, continuous rocker nose to tail, concave running through the front third, transitioning into soft roll bottom. 50/50 foiled rail, nice and fine in the tail. Equally at home in short beachies and long hollow point waves, turns from all over the board, drivey off the tail, forward trim and nose ride all day long, step back into a full roundhouse cut back. Im not a fan of the term “log”… this board is far more than that!

models.name: Super Mal
models.description: The Super Mal can be surfed like a short board, yet has the smooth glide, forward trim and paddle power of a mal. All Super Mal variants enjoy a refined rail with a subtle tucked edge and chine. This produces a board that offers with for ease of entry and forward area, but surfs like a narrower, shorter board. I have surfed and shaped for well over 50 years, I can attest this is of my all-time favourite designs. It’s an essential board in my and many of my customers’ quivers. It’s a fantastic one board option for travel which can easily be surfed in average waves, but will truly come alive when the swell turns up. I have taken mine to Bali and Sumatra, ridden it in waist-high to well overhead conditions and it has never let me down. I have been refining and evolving the Super Mal since the mid 1980’s. One constant though has been smooth low central rocker with a slightly accelerated nose tweak and progressive tail curve for built in performance. The Super Mal is a mid-length board ranging between 7 and eight feet plus. It is designed to carve in beachies, point and reef breaks. The ultimate mid length all-rounder, every surfer should have one in their quiver. It's a life time board.

models.name: The Navigator Glider
models.description: Designed around turning, trimming and gliding more so than nose riding. Experience the forward trim and the momentum unique to this style of board which has amazing natural board speed and can link up sections from way out the back. You can turn, transition rail to rail and cover a lot of area fast-you will glide past crumbling whitewater, and be connecting sections that no other board will do, all the way to the beach. The longer rail lines and rocker can take a little getting used to even if you’re used to 9 foot plus longboards, but once you dial into turning from the tail and stepping back for your turn, you’ll feel this board truly come to life. The Navigator has a wide wave range, from small to medium and even larger waves with a preference for a sloping face and a high curl . These boards are not suited to short sucky beach breaks but more typically trimming and easy rail to rail transitions. Typically built in the 9 to 12 foot range, this is not a mal, or a log, or a nose rider...it's a Glider! My design features low overall rocker with a continuous curve in the outline and bottom curve delivering smooth rail-to-rail transitions. With very refined rail volume , a sleek tapered foil and fine tail thickness, you get a sensitive feeling like that of a much smaller board. Surfers that own and ride my Gliders will tell you that they are one of their favourite boards. The sleek lines generate high board speed quickly and then build on it over the length of ride.

models.name: The OUTER FISH F1
models.description: The OUTER FISH F1 is expertly crafted to excel in small to medium wave conditions, prioritising an exhilarating and enjoyable ride. Its low rocker design enhances natural board speed and ensures effortless wave entry, making it ideal for quick takeoffs. T The concave shape beneath the standing area channels water efficiently toward the tail, generating impressive speed. Additionally, the subtle vee contours under the fin area offer a perfect balance of loose handling and precise control, allowing skilled surfers to confidently execute front foot tube rides. This board combines performance and fun for surfers seeking dynamic wave experiences.

models.name: The Outer FISH F2
models.description: The F2 is the weapon of choice when the waves get solid and hollow. With the planing area offering early entry and a tonne of speed from takeoff, the inbuilt speed courtesy of a lifetime refining concaves means you will be taking off deeper that you thought possible, racing and making sections that before, would have had you pulling back. In contrast to the standard wide and flat fish of the past, that aren’t capable of full rail turns or to sit well in tubes, the F2 has a fine tuned blend of performance rocker and modern rails, making it equally at home in the pocket or burying the rail for a scorching cutback. The Outer FISH is the fruit of a lifetime of shaping, riding, and refining board designs, hand foiling fins, experimenting with shape and placement of single, twin, tri fins and quads. My ethos as a shaper, designer and surfer has always been to infuse performance into all my boards so that the rider is surfing the wave, not thinking of what the board requires. This design translates well into longer sizes, aka ‘the long fish’.

models.name: The Phaza
models.description: The daily driver, reimagined, designed for hi speed energy pocket surfing. The PHAZA is a refined, responsive blade — minimal rocker, subtle concaves, and a hard edge running nose to tail. Using subtle concaves and pressure zones to generate lift it rides on air , delivering crisp , precision turns, and effortless speed with silky smooth rail-to-rail and front-to-back foot transitions Loose, alive, and perfectly balanced — the ultimate blend of flow and control.

models.name: THE SHIP WRECK
models.description: This easy paddle, high performance all-rounder is a staple in so many of my customers’ quivers - The “Ship Wreck” board. Onshore three feet to bombing, offshore overhead surf - the Shipwreck will do it all. It has a perfectly balanced outline with enough area up front for maximum paddle power and forward trim, easy duck dive but its not a ‘mal’ or ‘mid length’ … It’s hi performance big guy board, perfect choice for Indo The continuous curve in the outline and bottom curve encourages smooth rail-to-rail transitions. A central planing area of accelerated rocker give the board extended trim and glide through a variety of conditions. I’ve tested this design in a variety of local conditions and in Indonesia. It’s a design that never disappoints and reaffirms my decision to always slide it in the board bag. The Ship Wreck is confidence-inspiring and rewarding under foot. Available right through the size range from mid 6’8” to upper mid lengths in all tail shapes. Recommended fin configurations: Whilst most popular as a tri fin or tri quad combination. My personal choice is a quad with V2Flex. It all comes down to personal taste and surfing goals. Suggested wave range: 2 – 8 feet

models.name: THE WOLF
models.description: THE WOLF From the first surf this design proved to be a wolf in sheep's clothing...So I've called it The WOLF, super fast and free, hungry for barrels...the high hi volume makes a great board for summer slop too. It has a slight ‘beak ‘ nose, holding thickness and volume into the forward are, making it a great board for forward trimming. Low overall rocker gives it fabulous glide and run. It has a single to double concave with a little touch of panel vee under the back foot, lending a touch of the old school MP cutback feel. I've been riding mine as 2+1 with a 7“ Switch Blade, really nice in fuller, sloping faced waves. I ride it with 4 fins when the waves start to barrel. The Wolf has a really fresh feel, a nice departure from your every day board.

models.name: Zen Gun
models.description: When the sky is turning black at five times overhead and you’ve made the decision to turn and go, there is no room for second guessing yourself. Or your equipment. Doubt can’t come into it. This is the confidence machine. The best boards, the trusted boards, are the ones that you don’t have to think about. The Zen Gun is just that. Zen because you’re at one with your equipment. Zen because you’re trusting in your reflexes, your readiness and your focus. This beautiful, serious design encapsulates all that I know about optimised gun design: low entry rocker for early entry and generous tail rocker for catch-free release. Designed to paddle fast with super easy wave entry to get you in in early, with maximal natural board speed and the ability to carve and turn on XXXL waves of consequence with confidence. It has a clean, continuous curve, and a light vee bottom with double concaves to hold laminar flow, keeping the board on the water. Medium high nose rocker with an accelerated curve through the centre with sweet progressive tail curve to carve turns at maximum speed and power. Confidence inspiring volume is hidden in a forward-foiled, momentum-filled paddling machine. Fifty-five years of concave innovation and control surface knowledge in a pure Outer Island outline yield a marriage of a surefooted big wave board and the performance of a step up. This board comes standard with double leash plugs for extra strength in big waves. The rest is up to you….
